basic_info.description: In the heart of San Francisco's iconic Pacific Heights neighborhood, this stunning top floor residence offers luxurious living on a tree-lined street just block off Fillmore. This turn-key pied a terre boasts an open floor plan, with great room, spacious bedroom, gorgeous kitchen, complete with stainless appliances and eat-in peninsula, opens directly onto the expansive living and dining area. One of 8 units in a well-maintained boutique building that was extensively renovated with seismic upgrades in 2018. Other highlights include one-car garage parking, 2 deeded private storage, high-end finishes, hardwood floors with carpeted bedroom and free shared laundry. Just steps from Lower Pacific Heights, The Marina, Cow Hollow and Alta Plaza.
